decisions.reason: Proven government use and over 30 APIS connections show its value has resolved favourably, so the firm should commit further rather than abandon it.

Post-pandemic demand for travel health requirements is weak and uncertainty remains, but the API costs little to maintain and could serve wider travel-requirement data, so the option is held one more year, though it is close to being dropped.
The module is cheap to run alongside the certified training resources and offers upside in new sectors, so the option stays open.
